about.title: About Coastal Comfort
text: The only HVAC and refrigeration team based on Galveston's West End, so we're already on your side of the island when you need us. Built from nearly 70 years of combined expertise at Townley Refrigeration and Coastal Comfort, now one team.

Already have a written estimate from another HVAC company? Send it to us. We'll review it free of charge and tell you what's fair, what's not, and what the work should actually cost. It's our way of making sure folks on the Island and the mainland aren't getting taken for a ride.
From emergency repairs to full system installations, we keep Galveston homes and businesses comfortable year-round.
